links.outcome: LLM recognition of acute suicide risk in vignettes versus mental health providers
links.effect: GAI-LLMs rated the most acute case as less acute than MHCPs and the least acute case as more acute; ChatGPT-3.5 gave lower acute risk ratings than ChatGPT-4o and Gemini.
links.quote: GAI-LLMs' assessments showed discrepancies with MHCPs, particularly rating the most acute case as less acute and the least acute case as more acute.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance and consistency of multiple generative LLMs compared to mental health care providers on clinical suicide risk assessment vignettes, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
